content.title: Turkcell, Turk Telekom, Vodafone win frequencies in Turkey's $2.95 billion 5G tender
content.summary: ANKARA (Reuters) -Turkey's 5G spectrum tender drew a total of $2.95 billion in winning bids on Thursday, with the country's major operators Turkcell, Vodafone and Turk Telekom securing key blocks across the 700 MHz and 3.5 GHz frequency ranges.  Turkcell placed the highest bid of $429 million for the A1 package in the 700 MHz band and won four blocks in the 3.5 GHz range.  Turk Telekom secured the A3 package for $425 million and two blocks in the 3.5 GHz range.
